comment: Firmware the app recognizes by the checksum the calculator shows in its test menu (2.C). Shared with the Windows app: keep both copies identical. model is the full name including the manufacturer: “HP 15c Collector’s Edition”, “HP 16c Collector’s Edition”, or “HP 12c”. The app shows model + description, so description never repeats the model. fileName starts the default backup name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens); the app adds the checksum and date. List only publicly released firmware: never pre-release or advance copies.

firmware.description: June 2024 debounce, 16c mode fix, backup and restore
